recommended_directions: Identity-graph as keystone primitive: 5/5 flagged it; does existing single-provider identity extend to multi-provider account linking or is this a ground-up layer?

Quorum engine design: 5/5 want multi-human approvals; does quorum extend the existing ask-primitive (N targets + aggregation rule) or replace it? Separation-of-duties and expertise routing push beyond simple counting.

Live-session vs fork-first sequencing: 4/5 want live concurrent sessions, but it is the hardest NEW-PRIMITIVE. Is fork + handoff (existing session-fork) a viable v1, or does team mode collapse without live co-presence from day one?
The offboarding/retention/legal-hold triangle: these three are in direct tension (retention deletes, legal-hold preserves). Architect them together or the rebuild cost is high.
Policy-as-code layer ownership: policies span ACL, approvals, retention, quotas, incident mode, federation. One engine that every primitive calls, or distributed per-primitive?

Credential model: brokerage (mint-on-demand) vs lease (temporal scoping of existing secrets) vs attestation (operation-signing). Are these three faces of one credential primitive or distinct sub-primitives?
